name: Crown-Guard Blade of Culanwe
note: Left on a white marble plinth where the Rumare mist pools over Ayleid footings.

name: Chironasium Staff of Embers
note: Sealed in a brass case by an Arcane University proctor during the Oblivion Crisis.

name: Pelinal's Bridge-Vow Signet
note: Worn by an Imperial Watch captain who held the western bridgehead.

name: Red Ring Cohort Gladius
note: Notched against Daedric iron along the sunken causeway of Lake Rumare.

name: Battlehorn Castellan's Greatsword
note: Forged from Colovian karst-iron to hold the northwestern passes.

name: Stendarr's Crosier of Chorrol
note: Blessed beneath the Great Oak for the highland circuit healers.

name: Wendir Crown-Seeker's Bow
note: Carved from ridge-pine by a scout mapping the ten ancestral Ayleid vaults.

name: Hackdirt Watchman's Lantern-Blade
note: Found beside a collapsed limestone sinkhole outside Hackdirt.

name: Akaviri Oath-Blade of Pale Pass
note: Preserved in permafrost grease since Reman's Dragonguard sealed the pass.

name: Sancre Tor Barrow-Cleaver
note: Etched with the names of the northern pass-wardens who fell in the siege.

name: Talos Standard-Bearer's Talisman
note: Carried from Bruma's ramparts to the Great Gate scar.

name: Frostcrag Conduit Staff
note: Charged by the high-altitude storms that break over the Jerall crest.

name: Vindasel Soul-Tethered Edge
note: Resting on an Ayleid altar surrounded by shattered welkynd glass.

name: Weynon Priory Reliquary Amulet
note: Hidden under the chapel flagstones when the Mythic Dawn raided the road.

name: Harcane Unicorn-Watcher's Bow
note: Seasoned in Great Forest beech-smoke by an old forester.

name: Ceyatatar Worm-Hunter's Mace
note: Carried by a Mages Guild battlemage into the forest necromancer war.

name: Vahtacen Pillar-Key Staff
note: Inscribed with the four elemental Ayleid verses of the sealed chamber.

name: Corbolo Knight-of-the-Thorn Blade
note: Polished to a mirror shine for Count Indarys's chivalric order.

name: Lake Arrius Cinder-Ward Amulet
note: Recovered from the red volcanic caverns above the Corbolo headwaters.

name: Shurgak Clan Honor-Hammer
note: Tempered in Valus foothill ore at Lord Rugdumph's estate forge.

name: Miscarcand Welkynd-Forged Dagger
note: Cooled in the subterranean springs beneath the King of Miscarcand's vault.

name: Priory of the Nine Reliquary Shield
note: Bears the eight-spoked star of the old knights in the southern woods.

name: Hassildor's Midnight Signet
note: Found in a locked limestone cellar beneath Skingrad's vineyard terraces.

name: Julianos Scriptorium Rod
note: Bound in West Weald calfskin and tipped with meteoric glass.

name: Kvatch Siege-Breaker's Broadsword
note: Still darkened by Oblivion soot from the barricades of Castle Kvatch.

name: Garlas Malatar Meridian Bow
note: Gilded in seaside Ayleid bronze that never tarnishes in Abecean salt-spray.

name: Anvil Lighthouse Keeper's Talisman
note: Blessed at the Great Chapel of Dibella for ships rounding the headland.

name: Crowhaven Blood-Hunter's Silver Blade
note: Left on the parapet overlooking the Gold Coast cliffs.

name: Wenyandawik Crown-Guard Mace
note: Pulled from the willow-silt of an Ayleid vault north of Bravil.

name: Fort Grief Challenger's Axe
note: Won in a grim manhunt across the island battlements of Fort Grief.

name: Lucky Old Lady's Copper Token
note: Tucked beneath the canal-steps where Bravil's ferrymen pray for fair water.

name: Harcane Reed-Fletched Longbow
note: Strung with waxed river-sinew for the Nibenay Valley mist.

name: Nenalata Last-King's Scepter
note: Rests upon the half-sunken marble dais of the last Ayleid king.

name: Telepe Highwayman's Cutlass
note: Hidden in Black-Brugo's counting-room before the midnight split.

name: White Stallion Knight's Lance-Blade
note: Awarded by Count Marius Caro for clearing the Blackwood river roads.

name: Malada Sun-Bird Amulet
note: Pried from the vine-choked keystone wall in the eastern fens.
